# SWARM address encoding sources

Upstream published crates, MIT OR Apache-2.0:

- zcash_address 0.13.0, archive SHA256 5a854b28c07dba372f4410ea8ad62b4bf7d5c2bf8be32fc4b31bc0db6521a975
- zcash_protocol 0.10.4, archive SHA256 043686451284bcb72e40ffa18e2cdcea3108e8468e3d021062c0b32c4a060c98

Changes: three testnet unified HRP constants; typed legacy HRP aliases; legacy
serialization test expects canonical SWARM output and still tests legacy decode.
Every source change is generated by `scripts/address-prefix/prepare.py` in
brs-holding/privacy-network at c18d620. Its two-version proof passed baseline and
patched upstream suites plus 2304 fixtures per version in run 35911221293.

Integration validation: two prefix integration tests, 502 library
tests (12 pre-existing ignored), six CLI recovery tests, 13 zingolib feature
configurations and six zingo-cli configurations passed on Rust 1.97.1.

Online A/B benchmark, 2026-09-24, Rust 1.97.1, birthday 3492783, one mixnet
session per build, pinned server https://zec.rocks:443:

| Build | Boot seconds | Sync seconds | Wallet scan core-seconds |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Original parent 7a93dd13 | DNF | DNF | DNF |
| Parent with CLI compile repair | 43.299 | 15.262 | 11.410 |
| SWARM prefix candidate with same repair | 52.102 | 12.317 | 11.610 |

The original parent fails to compile with E0004 because its shard recovery
change added RebuildRequired without updating plan_recovery. Both runnable
builds include explicit Park handling, covered by a regression test. The
control therefore differs from the original parent. Single live-network
samples verify completion and provide no performance improvement claim.

Cargo patches in the top-level workspace select these sources. Downstream
Cargo workspaces must carry equivalent patches because Cargo ignores a
dependency's patch table. Coordinated node/server/client and payment acceptance
gates remain before any released wallet emits the new address spelling.
